newsitem.title: MEXICO: GBM Atlantico issues 200 mln pesos debt.
newsitem.headline: GBM Atlantico issues 200 mln pesos debt.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Financiero GBM Atlantico on Thursday issued 200 million pesos in mandatorily convertible subordinated debt.
The debt has a maturity of 2,576 days and carries an interest rate of 33.92 percent, paid every 28 days, the financial group said in information released by the Mexican Stock Exhchange.
The issue was part of a larger debt offer of 600 million pesos, the remainder of which will be placed at an unspecified future date.
The financial group said the debt will be convertible to the bank's A, B, or L shares.
Accival is acting as lead manager for the deal in Mexico.
